strings.en: The name's Michiru Hanaten!
Feast yer eyes on the G-Bankaran's power!
Oi! Glad ya made it, punk!
Brace yerself!
In a brawl, ya strike first!
Here we go, G-Bankaran!
Right, let's go in swingin'!
I'm gonna tear right through ya!
Leave it to me an' the G-Bankaran!
The G-Bankaran has arrived!
The G-Bankaran'll take ya on!
Keep mouthin' off an' I'll pound ya!
I'll beat some Vigor into ya with my fists!
Quit showin' off, Jua-Mu!
A real man's pride speaks through his fists!
A Raftclans? What's that to me?!
I can see right through yer black heart, Karo-Ran!
Ya don't look like ya got a shred of honor!
Don't get cocky, ya spoiled rich brat!
Yer game of emperor's over! Gu-Landon!
You the boss? I'm takin' ya down!
I'm comin' for the top dog's head!
I can't make heads or tails/　of what you're sayin'!
You? Rule the world? Get real, moron!
What kinda garbage are ya spoutin'!?
Vort! In a test of strength, I ain't losin'!
Can't pick a fight if yer scared of bleedin'!
Reggiane! I'll suck yer blood instead!
Yer reign ends here! Moron!!
Clown idiot! Quit showin' off on my home turf!
I'll crack that thick skull of yers!
I'll flatten ya an' stand ya next to the Kuidaore doll!
Yer headed for the circus, that's settled!
You're one weird dude, seriously!
One on one, Chestnut!
Get lost, Chestnut!
I'll smash ya an' sell ya to a jeweler!
I'll rip those wings right off!
I'll rattle more'n yer back teeth, I'll rattle all of ya!
Don't think ya'll get off with broken bones, punk!
Skeletons go straight to the graveyard!
Strongest in yer army? So what?!/　I'm the head boss of the/　Kansai Todoroki Student Alliance!
I'll sink yer Kashin warship in Dotonbori!
I'm sick an' tired of aliens!
You punks never learn, do ya!
I'll gift-wrap ya an' ship ya back to the edge of space!
Like I'd get scared of some alien!
Look down on Earthlings and ya get burned!
Get ready, Golaikunru!
I'll wreck yer whole business!
Stickin' a weird chimney on yerself!
I'll kick that walnut of yers!
I'll snap that horn right off!
Quit flittin' around! It's annoyin'!
Ya think I'm scared of a scythe like that?!
A test of strength? Bring it on!
I ain't lettin' you punks have yer way with Kita!
What a creepy mug!
I'll take out these Lamaris in no time!
Lamaris, get lost already!
Lamaris are a pain, dammit!
So the small fry Combine, so what?!
What a disgustin' monster!
I'll take out whatever that clown idiot left behind!
Ida or Umeda or whatever, I'll beat ya down!
What the? What a weird bunch!
So they're monsters. Big deal!
I'll toss the whole lot of 'em out!
Get outta my way!
Quit fussin'!
Who d'ya think you are, punk!?
Don't get cocky, ya moron!
I'm payin' ya back in full!
Right then, here I come!
Ya want a fight, ya got one!
Payback, right now!
Hold it right there, punk!
N-No good! This is it!!
Wh-What the hell?!
N-No way, that's nuts!!
Wh-Why you! Knock it off already!
Th-This is a total mess now!!
Ngh! That's just brutal!!
Pullin' cheap tricks like that,/　I swear!
Like I'm gonna get wiped out in one go!
I'll show ya some Kansai Guts!!
It starts now!/　The real fight starts here!!
Ngh! I ain't dyin'.../　not while Shoko's around!!
B-Bring it on!/　I'll show ya the G-Bankaran's Potential!
Sh-Shoko... Give me strength!!
Ya got me, Jua-Mu!
What d'ya think yer doin', So-Des?!
Tch, Al-Van/　landed a good one on me!
You witch! Don't mess with me!
Are ya gonna fight or not?!/　Make up yer mind!
C-Cut it out, you black creep!
Caught it, Karo-Ran!!
Nngh... I ain't lettin' you take the top spot!
If I take any more/　of that weird crap,/　I'm done for!
Th-This big showdown.../　is gettin' good now...!
Tch! Not bad, Vort!
That idiot's bottomless!
Th-That thing looks tough AND hits tough!!
I ain't payin' for yer act!
Damn Chestnut, makin' a fool of me!
Just bones, an' what strength!
Damn XN-L, that's nasty!
I-Is this what they call the mysteries of space?!
Golaikunru! Just you wait!
If a thorn's stuck in ya, just pull it out.
It ain't just the looks that're tough...!
Did that idiot go Training across the Sanzu River?!
If a monster takes me out,/　I'll never rest in peace!!
What the hell, ya moron!
You got me! I won't forget this!
Whoa there,/　that one really landed...!
Heh, that woke me right up!
Not bad, punk!
That black one got me good!
Hmph,/　guess you earned bein' the boss.
Dammit, what is that?!/　That crazy attack!
Th-The looks, the attacks... it's nuts!
Tch,/　guess bein' huge ain't just for show!
Like I'd lose to some alien!
Don't get cocky, alien!
Dammit, movin' all weird like that!
What's with how that thing moves?!
You're creepin' me out!
Urgh! A monster got me good!
That didn't even tickle.
What a weak-ass attack!
What, that's all ya got?
Whoa, what d'ya think yer doin'?!
That ain't enough to stop the G-Bankaran!
Hah, quit with the cheap tricks!
Well, not bad, I guess.
Heh, that tickles.
Ya got the guts, at least, Jua-Mu!
Are ya a wimp?! So-Des!
Al-Van!/　Ya can't beat the G-Bankaran!
Well, you're a woman, so I'll go easy on ya.
Tch! That black one's fast!
What a lousy move, Karo-Ran!
Yer punches got no heart!/　Ya think people'll follow that?!
How d'ya lead anybody like that?
All that yappin' is why/　ya can't close the deal!
Ain't got time for a scythe!
Huh? Weren't ya gonna suck my blood?
So that's all the Cross Gate's power amounts to?!
What, all bark and no bite.
Outta magic tricks already?!
Is that freaky body of yours just papier-mache?!
Well, ya are a skeleton. No wonder it's light.
XN-L! That ain't gonna be enough to take my life!
Can't ya see it's pointless, spaceman?!
Aliens? They're nothin'!
Call it a handicap, alien!
Hmph, what soft little thorns!
Weird trick, but it ain't workin'.
What a wimpy monster.
Hmph, funny attack ya got there!
Like that'd hit me!
Where ya lookin'?!
Wimp! Go back and try again!
Idiot! Moron!
You gutless wonder!
Rushin' won't get ya anywhere!
Like I'd let a spaceman beat me!
Fancy toys don't mean squat if ya can't hit!
Don't underestimate Earthlings, ya moron!
As if you could ever make it to the top!
Save that stuff for the circus, would ya!
You must be blind!
Is your size the only big thing about ya, XN-L?!
That's what ya get for showin' off!
Tch, I screwed up!
All right! My turn!
I'll hit 'em from this side too!
Don't forget about me!
Chargin' in, G-Bankaran!
This one's on the house!
Shoko, lemme give ya a hand!
I've got your back,/　Shoko!
Kota! You owe me one!
Fine, I'll help ya out!
Boss lady, I'm lendin' a hand!
Never thought I'd end up lendin' YOU a hand!
Not on my watch!
Comin' through!
I can take a beatin'!
Leave this to me!
It ain't gonna go that easy!
Keep your hands off my pals!
Shoko, look out!
For Shoko, I'll...!
This ain't for you,/　it's for Shoko!
If somethin' happens to you,/　Shoko's gonna be sad!
Boss lady, I'll handle this!
I'm savin' ya, so ya better be grateful till ya die!
Here's another one!
I'll smack ya, punk!
I'll pound ya one more time!
Whatcha lookin' at, punk?!
I'll stare ya down!
I ain't good at aimin'!
Take this kick!
Kick first!
I'll pound ya!
Ora-ora-ora-ora-oraaaah!!
I'll finish ya!!
Next, my iron fist!
I'll pound ya till ya drop dead!!
Off ya go!!
Aw, crap!
Here I come!!
Nnngraaah!!
Yer a pushover!
Stay right there!
Hraah!
Wooraah!
Too late to cry and beg now!!
Doryaaah!!
Go meet yer maker!!
Move and...!
I'll blow ya away!!
I told ya not to move,/　ya moron!!
Heave-ho!
Take thiiis!!
What the heck?!
You lot! Ready to cross the River Styx?!
Ya better be!!
I'd stake my life on the woman I love!
That's what bein' a man's all about!
Hraaah!!
Uuuuraa!
Smack! Smack! Smaaack!!
Smack, smack, smack/　till ya go down!!
Get lost, ya moron!!
Shoko, did ya see me out there?
Now, let's go grab some grilled squid.
Here I go!!
Finishin' moooove!!
8710 Dragon and Tiger Barrage!!
Ora-ora-ora-ora-oraaah!!
Hraah! Get lost!!
That's the pennant for the Titans!
Now, let's go grab some tea.
What're you lookin' at, huh?!
